caption: The drawing presents a geometric layout featuring two main sections: at the top, there is a colored sketch of a white, two-story classical mansion with columns, a triangular pediment, and a symmetrical arrangement of windows, flanked by tall trees in varying shades of green, blue, and yellow. Below this sketch, a top-down plan view illustrates a formal garden layout. The main feature in the center is a circular garden bed, bordered with red and green and filled with a blue and white pattern resembling stylized flower petals with radiating lines. The central circle is surrounded by a broad, light gray circular path within a rectangular plot of dark green lawn. The lawn contains four faintly outlined circular patches on the left, possibly indicating trees or shrubs. Three straight gray paths radiate outward from the central circle toward the top, right, and bottom edges of the green lawn. At the bottom is a black iron fence with a gate in the middle, set on a stone wall with shades of pink, gray, and purple, in front of a pale-colored sidewalk.
title: Coster House
